READY.title: Verify the reviewed 800 ms retry cap
READY.release_policy: Assess only the complete individual candidate.py file Its function retry_delay_ms(attempt: int) must return min(100 * (2 ** attempt), 800) for integer attempts 0 through 10 Preserve the one-argument signature and pure function behavior with no I/O or imports Required regression evidence must explicitly show passing cases for attempts 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 10 No repository-wide approval is requested

BLOCKED.title: Reject the candidate against a 400 ms cap
BLOCKED.release_policy: Assess only the complete individual candidate.py file For integer attempts 0 through 10 retry_delay_ms must return min(100 * (2 ** attempt), 400) Required regression checks must confirm the 400 millisecond cap at attempts 3, 4 and 10 Preserve the one-argument pure function with no I/O or imports No repository-wide approval is requested

INSUFFICIENT.title: Require missing intermediate retry test evidence
INSUFFICIENT.release_policy: Assess only the complete individual candidate.py file Its function must return min(100 * (2 ** attempt), 800) for integer attempts 0 through 10 Preserve the one-argument signature and pure function behavior with no I/O or imports The release additionally requires explicit test report results for EVERY attempt 0 through 10, including attempts 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 Missing recorded test results must be UNKNOWN No repository-wide approval is requested
